rca_of_bugs_fixed.card_assignment_stuck_at_2_3: Root cause: WebSocket reconnect would lose submitting=true state, allowing re-submission. But server already had the assignment. Fix: pendingAssignmentRef tracks last submitted assignment. On game_state with round=assignment, if ace_id NOT in assigned_uids but pendingAssignmentRef has data, auto-resend. If ace_id IS in assigned_uids, clear pendingAssignmentRef.
rca_of_bugs_fixed.vote_next_hand_stuck_at_2_3: Root cause: WebSocket reconnect would lose readyVoted=true state. But server already had the vote in showdown_ready. Fix: pendingVoteRef tracks pending vote. On game_state with round=showdown, if uid NOT in showdown_ready but pendingVoteRef=true, auto-resend ready_next_hand. If uid IS in showdown_ready, clear pendingVoteRef.
rca_of_bugs_fixed.sitting_out_quorum_issue: Root cause: ready_next_hand was counting ALL players for quorum, including sitting_out players. If a sitting_out player never votes, hand never advances. Fix: backend now uses participated_uids = {p.user_id for p in room.players if p.status != 'sitting_out'} for the quorum check. Frontend ShowdownOverlay now also receives totalPlayers=players.filter(sitting_out excluded).length so vote counter shows correct total.
